Hi team,

Quick update on the Q3 customer portal migration. We hit the milestone we set for end of last week: all legacy account records have been migrated to the new platform and passed the first round of reconciliation checks. Out of roughly 48,000 records, 99.7% matched exactly, and the remaining 0.3% have been flagged with reasons (mostly duplicate email addresses from pre-2015 sign-ups). Thanks to Marcus for pulling those exception reports so quickly.

Next steps for this week:
- Finish manual review of the flagged duplicates with the support team by Wednesday
- Run the load test on the staging environment at expected peak traffic
- Confirm the rollback plan with infrastructure before we schedule the cutover

We're still on track for the October 14 cutover window, though the load test is the item that could move that date if we find performance issues. I'll send the test results as soon as they're in.

If you have concerns about any of the open items, reply here or grab me before Thursday's standup.

Best,
Daniel

Subject: Weekly status update – Q3 onboarding project

Hi team,

Here's where things stand at the end of the week.

Onboarding revamp: The new welcome checklist is in final review. Marcus has finished the copy edits, and design sign-off is expected Tuesday. We're on track for the October pilot.

Vendor integration: The API handshake with the payroll provider is working in staging. Two edge cases remain around partial-month pro-rating, and Sana is testing those fixes now.

Customer feedback: We collected 46 responses from the August survey. The top request is clearer timelines for account setup, which the new checklist addresses directly.

Blockers: We're waiting on legal to approve the updated data retention language. I've followed up twice and will escalate Monday if I haven't heard back.

Next week: Finalize the pilot cohort list, run the first end-to-end test with the payroll sandbox, and draft the launch communication for managers.

Thanks, everyone, for the steady progress this week. Shout out to Sana for working through the pro-rating issues so quickly.

Best,
Daniel
